subject: English
title: CBSE English, Class XI

source.read: CBSE curriculum 2025-26, English Core (301), Classes XI and XII: the Class XI course
source.note: Read through a text summary of the PDF, not the PDF itself. The board's prescribed chapters are named, not reproduced; the course is examined mainly through the textbooks, which are not in the app.

licence: Strand names as printed (facts). Every outcome is written by OpenPath in its own words; no curriculum or textbook text is reproduced.
review: OpenPath curriculum inventory (AI-assisted research from secondary sources; not an educator review)

outcomes.text: Reads a factual, descriptive or literary passage and a case-based passage with data.
outcomes.note: Reading passages have questions, and charts are read in Notes, charts and maps; long passages built on data are not yet in the app.

outcomes.text: Makes notes with a title, numbering and a key, from a passage.
outcomes.note: A title and the main points are chosen from a passage; numbering and a key are not asked for.

outcomes.text: Writes a summary of a passage in about fifty words.
Fills gaps with tenses and clauses, and reorders and transforms sentences.
Writes a classified advertisement and a poster.
outcomes.note: Written here or on paper to a task set for this class. The learner checks it against a short list and a grown-up ticks what they see. The app does not keep or mark the writing; the essay studio gives a closer analysis where an evaluator is connected.

outcomes.text: Writes a speech from word or picture cues.
outcomes.note: Done aloud with a grown-up, who ticks what they heard. The app cannot hear or mark speaking.

outcomes.text: Writes a debate on a topical issue.
outcomes.note: Written here or on paper to a task set for this class. The learner checks it against a short list and a grown-up ticks what they see. The app does not keep or mark the writing; the essay studio gives a closer analysis where an evaluator is connected.

outcomes.text: Reads the prose of Hornbill and answers questions on extracts and the whole.
outcomes.note: Long reads practise questions on theme, character and plot on OpenPath's own stories; the board's own textbook chapters are not in the app.

outcomes.text: Reads the poems of Hornbill and explains their devices.
outcomes.note: Poems and everyday texts asks about purpose, point of view and figurative language on OpenPath's own poems; the textbook's poems are not in the app.

outcomes.text: Reads the stories and play of Snapshots and writes about character and theme.
outcomes.note: Long reads practise questions on theme, character and plot on OpenPath's own stories; the board's own textbook chapters are not in the app.

outcomes.text: Follows talks, news and business information and answers questions.
outcomes.note: Questions on passages heard are practised; notes from a long talk are not.

outcomes.text: Speaks in discussions, interviews and presentations.
outcomes.note: Done aloud with a grown-up, who ticks what they heard. The app cannot hear or mark speaking.

outcomes.text: Completes a research project of about 900 words and talks about it.
outcomes.note: Done with a grown-up, away from the app, who ticks what they saw.
